::: {#hero-heading}
I am an economist and data scientist at **SWICA**, where I design alternative financing and value-based care models and test whether they work, using claims data. I teach data science and programming for economists at the **University of St. Gallen**, and co-organize the Zurich R User Group.

When I’m not working on this, I’m probably running, biking, doing politics for my township, or cooking.

Feel free to **get in touch** using my contact info.
:::
